title: Intelligence Brief
subtitle: The AI vulnerability-disclosure wave is here: ~1,5, The inference price war moved into hardware: GLM-5, Mistral's Leanstral 1.5 makes formal proof a free

heroStat.label: June's high/critical CVE disclosures vs the pre-Mythos monthly record — the Glasswing wave has started

insights.text: The AI vulnerability-disclosure wave is here: ~1,500 high/critical CVEs in June (3.5× the pre-Mythos record, per Epoch AI), Project Glasswing sitting on 10,000+ more, and strix AI-pentesting at #1 on GitHub trending for a second straight day (+2,803 stars).
insights.source: Hacker News / Epoch AI / GitHub Trending

insights.text: The inference price war moved into hardware: GLM-5.2 serves on AMD MI355X at 2,626 tok/s/node at over 2× lower cost than Blackwell, with MXFP4 quantization measured lossless — SemiAnalysis independently puts MI355X at $0.49/Mtok vs B300's $0.74.

Mistral's Leanstral 1.5 makes formal proof a free commodity: Apache-2.0, 119B MoE with only 6.5B active, solves 587 of 672 PutnamBench problems, framed by Mistral as the trust layer for vibe-coded software.

SCOTUS ruled 6-3 in Chatrie v. US that geofence location data held by a third-party company is a Fourth Amendment search — the biggest narrowing of the third-party doctrine since Carpenter, though warrants weren't banned outright.

Local SOTA is now a purchasing decision, not a research project: jamesob's local-llm guide (311 HN points) is a literal bill of materials — $2k buys Qwen3.6-27B, $40k buys a quantized GLM-5.2 594B rig with whisper STT included.

The frontier-distillation leak is now a genre: the Qwythos-9B 'Claude-Mythos-5' distill holds #1 on Hugging Face at 1.37M downloads (+112k/day), joined by versioned gemma-4 'fable5' distill product lines at 628k downloads — still zero independent benchmarks.

Local-first sync reached product grade: Bramble password manager (116 HN points) syncs P2P over a self-hostable Nostr relay + WebRTC with no vault server and doubles as a passkey authenticator, while Opbox brings CRDT sync to plain files on disk.

Bearish counterweight from the largest deployer: Zuckerberg told Meta staff AI agents haven't progressed as quickly as expected — said the week agent harness repos dominated GitHub trending and caveman token-optimization grew +2,863 stars in a day.
